rankings.strongest_idea: Expose one orchestration façade and one session format while delegating policy to the existing domain-specific reducers.

rankings.fatal_flaw: Five program ADTs, extensive branded proofs, effect receipts, a capability broker, and separate Fugue pipelines create substantially more conceptual and structural machinery than the orchestration requires.
rankings.strongest_idea: Use parser-produced CompleteRoster evidence to prevent partial aggregation without spreading checks throughout the runtime.

rankings.fatal_flaw: Mandatory DAG execution for every operation plus hash-linked events, write-ahead publication states, grants, receipts, anchored stores, and index compare-and-swap over-fortifies the system and makes routine orchestration difficult to understand or change.
rankings.strongest_idea: Use an anchored RunDirHandle with fixed operations so callers never manipulate arbitrary artifact paths.
